content.name: Ivana Petrović
content.title: IT Support Specialist (2nd Level)
content.summary: Fachinformatikerin für Systemintegration (IHK) with nine years of IT support in Köln, across logistics, insurance brokerage and media. Handles 2nd level support for 350 users at a media house and led its move to Microsoft Intune with GDPR-compliant device policies. Supports colleagues in German, Croatian and English.

experience.title: IT System Administrator (1st/2nd Level)
bullets: Kept handheld scanners, label printers and warehouse PCs running for three depots on two shifts.
Built a spare-device pool and swap procedure that brought scanner downtime per fault from hours to about 15 minutes.
Took over the company's patch day after my Ausbildung and documented it so colleagues could cover holidays.

experience.title: IT Support Specialist
bullets: Equipped 120 brokers for remote work within three weeks in spring 2020, including VPN, softphones and encrypted laptops.
Introduced a ticket system (OTRS) and SLAs, replacing support requests by phone and email with tracked tickets.
Worked with the external data protection officer on device and access rules aligned with the GDPR.
Trained staff in small groups on phishing and safe handling of customer data.

experience.title: IT Support Specialist (2nd Level)
bullets: Provide 2nd level support for 350 editorial, production and sales staff on Windows and macOS.
Led the migration of 410 devices to Microsoft Intune, with compliance policies agreed with the works council (Betriebsrat).
Reduced average ticket resolution time by 28% by building request templates and automating software installs.
Coordinate with external vendors for broadcast and print hardware and mentor the department's current Auszubildender.

education.degree: Fachinformatikerin für Systemintegration (IHK) – vocational qualification in systems integration
education.school: IHK Köln (dual training with Rheinauhafen Logistik GmbH)

achievements.title: Mentor for IT apprentices
achievements.detail: Supervise one Auszubildender each year after passing the AEVO trainer exam.

achievements.title: Volunteer, Köln repair café
achievements.detail: Repair laptops and phones for neighbours once a month.
